text:
maria: Heads-up — onboarding saffron-v1q-lite (int8) canary is spiking schema failures for function/tool calls in multilingual prompts.
aj: Ugh, any reproducible example?
maria: Yep. We get nested-escaped JSON in the funcall args that the router/validator treats as a string instead of an object. Example from a failing trace:
```
{"tool":"create_event","args":"{\"title\":\"Marta\\u2019s sync\",\"start\":\"2026-03-23T10:00:00Z\"}"}
```
aj: So args is a JSON-encoded string rather than a parsed dict. That will blow up a strict schema that expects an object.
sanjay: Did this start after we switched the kernel quant scheme on saffron?
maria: Timeline matches the int8 rollout to the canary pool yesterday + a few multilingual prompts that include curly apostrophes and non-ascii. Evals-bot shows schema_acceptance dropped: 0.87 -> 0.62 for funcall runs.
evals-bot: note: saffron-v1q-lite-canary | funcall-schema-pass: 62% | baseline (fp16) 88% | sample N=500 | top error: args_type_mismatch (42%), truncated_json (28%).
ying: Might be tokenization inserting extra escape sequences during streaming. Did we see double-escaping on the stream boundary?
maria: yes — streaming boundary + prefix KV cache sometimes slices mid-utf8 sequence, model emits \"\\u2019\" rather than the raw ’. That then gets wrapped into a string literal by the generation policy, so downstream sees a string containing an encoded JSON payload.
aj: Short-term fix: postprocess validators to attempt one-level unescape if args is string and looks like JSON. Cheap and pretty safe as a canary bandaid.
sanjay: Also add a heuristic that rejects args strings > 1MB or with control chars. We should avoid accidentally unwrapping arbitrary blobs.
ying: Long-term: update tokenization anchors for multilang + quant kernels so we avoid mid-codepoint cuts on the canary path. File a runtime ticket.
maria: Agree. Also we saw duplicate tool invocations when our retry stack replays because parse fails after ack. That inflated call counts by ~12% today.
aj: Can we change retry behavior to delay only after validator ack instead of on immediate parse? Might reduce duplicates but increases latency. Tradeoff.
sanjay: For canary I suggest: 1) enable soft-unescape postprocess, 2) tighten retry dedupe (idempotency key for funcalls), 3) add a lightweight schema_fallback that attempts parse-with-unescape and increments a telemetry label.
maria: I'll push a quick patch for (1) + telemetry flag. Can someone own (2) idempotency? @aj?
aj: On it. Will add id key to client-visible funcall wrapper and update router.
infra-bot: deploy triggered: canary-saffron-int8-fix-2026-03-23 by maria — will rollout to 5% shards.
evals-bot: scheduled re-eval in 30m. Suggest collecting per-lang breakdown and streaming-boundary tag.
ying: one more note — some of the failures only surface when tool args include nested arrays with unicode; add unit tests that fuzz nested structures with multilang text.
sanjay: I'll add the fuzz harness and run overnight.
maria: Thanks. If results look good tomorrow we can increase canary and consider kernel rollback if not. :thumbsup:
aj: Logging follow-up: capture raw token stream for 50 failed requests to debug escape origins.
maria: adding that to the patch. Will post short postmortem if mitigation doesn't restore >=80% schema_acceptance.
